purpose: Original world and character sprites for the visual overhaul

prompts.tree: Use case: game-asset. Create ONE complete original broadleaf oak tree sprite for a polished top-down 16-bit farming RPG in the warm, richly detailed countryside pixel-art style of Stardew Valley. Full tree, roots to canopy, isolated on genuinely transparent background, no ground tile, no text. This must be a PRODUCTION GAME SPRITE, crisp native pixel art authored on approximately a 64x72 logical-pixel grid and enlarged uniformly with nearest-neighbor square pixels. A broad, lush, asymmetrical connected crown with soft stepped organic silhouette, many interlocking rounded leaf clusters, interesting gaps within the crown, olive and sage greens, golden sunlit upper-left leaves, deep cool green shadows beneath, substantial warm brown trunk narrowing into visible branching limbs embedded in the foliage, little roots. Slight overhead RPG camera showing a little top of the crown and front of trunk, like Stardew Valley trees. Not a flat icon or a diagram. Beautifully articulated foliage volumes, subtle selective outlines rather than heavy black outlines, 20-32 intentional colors. Complete tree centered, generous transparent margin all around. No shadow, no grass island, no frame, no UI. Original tree design, not a copy of a game sprite.
prompts.farmer: Use case: game-asset. Create a polished original CHARACTER SPRITE TURNAROUND SHEET for a top-down pixel-art farming RPG, with the charming detailed proportions and warm color design of Stardew Valley villagers. Genuinely transparent background. Exactly FOUR complete full-body sprites of the SAME young adult farmer, in one horizontal row with large equal clear spacing: first facing the camera (south/front), second facing right (east/profile), third facing away (north/back), fourth facing left (west/profile). All four exactly same size, standing relaxed, same foot baseline, entirely separate without overlap. This is production sprite art authored at about 24x36 logical pixels per person, enlarged uniformly in sharp square nearest-neighbor pixels, no anti-aliasing, no painting. Original appealing farmer: fluffy wavy chestnut hair, warm expressive face, small natural nose and two dark eyes visible in front view, pale sage work shirt with rolled cream cuffs, rich blue denim dungarees with brass strap buttons, brown belt and sturdy warm leather boots, small tan tool pouch at hip. Head about 12 pixels high and torso plus legs about 22, comfortably rounded human proportions, shoulders and hands clearly attached, two substantial legs. Hair has a rounded irregular volume with three shade clusters and glints of warm sunlight; clothes have readable folds, pockets and warm/cool shadow contrast. No hat hiding hair, no tool or object in hands, no labels, no text, no diagram, no ground, no extra sprites, no watermark, no tall skinny body or featureless face. The north/back sprite shows back of hair, collar and crossed dungaree straps; side views show cheek and one eye. Warm sophisticated 18-28 color palette. Give the sheet a wide landscape composition.
prompts.cottage: Use case: game-asset. Create ONE beautiful complete original timber farm cottage sprite for a polished top-down 16-bit farming RPG, warm detailed pastoral pixel-art style reminiscent of Stardew Valley. Genuinely transparent background. Slight top-down 3/4 RPG view, front door facing down toward viewer, front facade and broad roof both visible, complete building silhouette, no terrain tile or surrounding scene. Production pixel sprite authored at approximately 96x88 logical pixels, enlarged with crisp square nearest-neighbor pixels, controlled 28-40 colors, no smooth illustration. Cozy golden oak and cream plaster cottage, richly shaded terracotta red-orange shingles in offset rows, asymmetrical cross-gabled roof with a small dormer, stone chimney, warm amber windows in dark wooden frames, curved timber doorway, three stone steps, flower boxes with tiny cream flowers and ivy, a small firewood stack at side. Strong roof outline, deep warm shadows beneath eaves, sunlight from upper left, original architecture, beautiful wood joinery and texture, roof made of carefully placed individual pixel shingles. No big black outline. No ground, grass, tree, floor tile, fence, signboard, letters, UI, border or watermark. Center with generous transparent margins.

farmer_proportions.prompt: Edit this original farmer turnaround sheet. Keep the same farmer identity, fluffy chestnut hair, warm skin and expressive face, sage rolled-sleeve work shirt, blue denim dungarees, brass buttons, tool pouch and brown boots. Keep exactly four separate full-body views in one horizontal row, ordered south/front, east/right profile, north/back, west/left profile, all on the same baseline and scale, genuinely transparent background. CHANGE THE ANATOMICAL PROPORTIONS to the compact, appealing actual in-game proportions of a Stardew Valley-style top-down farmer, not a tall illustrated child. Target an authored native sprite approximately 18-20 pixels wide by 32 pixels tall. The full rounded head INCLUDING HAIR is about 13 pixels tall and 15 pixels wide; torso from shoulders through hips about 9 pixels tall; legs and boots together about 10 pixels tall. Enlarge the head slightly relative to the old body, shorten the overly long torso, shorten the lower legs, bring the shoulders naturally just under the jaw with almost no exposed neck, and make the hands small and naturally attached at hip level. Preserve substantial separate legs with a comfortable stance. Overall roughly 2.5 heads tall, cute but still a young adult farmer, not a baby or a caricature. Front and back views about 18-20 pixels wide and profile views about 14-16 pixels wide. Let the forearms remain short and relaxed, no dangling long arms or oversized cuffs. Every view must use the same anatomy and the same body length. Slightly overhead classic farming RPG camera; show some top of the hair. Crisp deliberately placed native square pixel clusters enlarged uniformly, sophisticated warm 20-28 color palette, selective outlines and careful highlights. Reduce fussy microdetails so face, hair, collar, dungaree straps, pockets and boots remain beautifully readable at a real 32-pixel game height. No text, no labels, no ground, no props held in hands, no borders, no extra sprites. Output only the revised four-view character sheet.

props_and_tools.prompt: Use case: game-asset. Create an original production SPRITE ATLAS for a polished cozy top-down 16-bit farming RPG, with rich, warm native pixel art craftsmanship reminiscent of Stardew Valley. Genuinely transparent background. EXACT 4 by 4 uniform grid of 16 separate objects, one object centered in EACH equal cell, generous transparent spacing so every object is fully separate and nothing crosses a cell boundary. NO drawn grid, no labels, no text, no ground tiles, no scenery, no border or watermark. Objects ordered exactly left to right, top to bottom: ROW ONE: (1) a rustic farming HOE with a long golden-brown wooden handle and short broad perpendicular dark steel hoe blade, (2) a woodcutting AXE with an amber wooden handle and a substantial curved silver steel axe head on one side, (3) a PICKAXE with a long curved pointed double-ended iron pick head and wooden handle, (4) a rounded muted blue galvanized WATERING CAN with a clear handle, long spout and rose sprinkler head. ROW TWO: (5) a cream paper SEED PACKET with a tiny sprout illustration and red folded top, (6) a long slender curved FISHING ROD with a reel, visible pale line and little red bobber, (7) a woven HARVEST BASKET full of leafy radishes and a pumpkin, (8) a beautiful rustic SHIPPING CHEST with warm wooden slats, dark iron corner bands, hinges, a small brass latch, closed arched lid, and strong 3/4 top-down depth. ROW THREE: (9) a natural irregular cluster of three blue-grey ROCKS with angled facets and moss, (10) a lush tuft of WILD GRASS with distinct thin curling blades, varied olive/sage greens and tiny dry gold tips, (11) a small round STONE WELL with wooden posts, terracotta shingle canopy, dark blue water and a little bucket, (12) a wooden VILLAGE NOTICE BOARD on two posts with pinned cream paper and a tiny leaf symbol but no letters. ROW FOUR: (13) a short bundle of stacked cut LOGS showing concentric end grain and warm bark, (14) a small pile of light grey quarried STONES, (15) a little copper-and-silver FARM SPRINKLER on a short upright pipe with two horizontal spray arms, (16) a plump fresh silver-blue FISH with scales, fins, eye and pale belly. Every sprite is genuine crisp pixel art authored around a 24 by 24 logical-pixel grid (well and board about 32 by 32), enlarged uniformly with sharp square pixels, coherent scale and lighting from upper left, 16-28 carefully chosen colors per object, beautiful warm highlights and cool shadow clusters, selective outlines, readable silhouettes. Individual objects only, not tiny painted illustrations. Tools should have immediately distinct recognizable shapes and fit diagonally within their cell. Keep background genuinely transparent.

alternating_gait.integration: Neutral standing art bound to torso, two arms and two legs; one eight-phase clock with opposite same-side arm/leg motion; distance driven; source key poses retained for tool actions and provenance
